correctness.rationale: The three-state transfer encodes all admissible words. Exact M(-1)^4=I gives period-four zeros and witnesses. P^4=I mod 2 and P^8=I mod 4, with a four-position parity check for the coordinate-degree matrix B, prove uniform congruences. Sharp witnesses attain 1,2,4 in the respective classes. Exact direct Walsh and transfer calculations agree at every frequency for n=1..16; the general conclusion rests on the matrix proof, not finite extrapolation.
